title: Study Designed to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of the Neurolyser XR After Marketing Approval
official: Prospective, Multicenter, International, Post-Market, Observational Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Neurolyser XR
summary: The Neurolyser XR demonstrated positive outcomes in the clinical studies prior to obtaining CE marking, and well as in multiple pilot trials performed globally. This Post-Market Clinical Follow-up study is required to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the Neurolyser XR under real-world conditions.
conditions: Facet Joint Pain; Low Back Pain
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Diagnosis of lumbar zygapophyseal pain and eligible for treatment with the Neurolyser XR according to standard clinical practice.
2. Ability to understand the study requirements and provide informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Participation in another interventional clinical study that may interfere with the outcomes of this study.
2. Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
